description: Service class providing device management operations such as create, update, delete, retrieve, and search functions for Device entities, annotated as a Spring @Service with transactional behavior.

classes.name: DeviceService
classes.description: Spring service class handling device-related operations with dependency injection of a device repository, transaction management, and various CRUD and search methods.

methods.name: getAllDevices
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of devices associated with a specified user ID.

methods.name: getDeviceById
methods.description: Fetches a device by its ID for a specific user.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates a new device entity for a user, setting default status to 'Online'.

methods.name: updateDevice
methods.description: Updates device details if found, otherwise throws exception.

methods.name: deleteDevice
methods.description: Deletes a device if it exists; throws exception otherwise.

methods.name: searchDevices
methods.description: Searches devices by a search term; returns all devices if search term is empty.

methods.name: getDevicesByProtocol
methods.description: Retrieves devices matching a specific protocol for a user.

methods.name: getDeviceStatistics
methods.description: Returns aggregated device data grouped by protocol for a user.

methods.name: updateDeviceStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified device if it exists.
